sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt: DILUTION If you invest in our Common Stock in this offering, your ownership interest may be diluted or benefitted immediately to the extent of the difference between the price per share you pay in this offering and the as adjusted net tangible book value per share of our Common Stock immediately after giving effect to this offering. Our historical net tangible book deficit as of June 30, 2026 was $(91.8) million, or $(19.07) per share of our Common Stock. Net tangible book value is total assets minus the sum of total liabilities and intangible assets. Net tangible book value per share is net tangible book value divided by the total number of shares of our Common Stock outstanding as of June 30, 2026.
